# wso2is_branding_text (Resource)

Changes the text on one login or self-service screen, in one language (locale). The text applies to the whole organization or to one application. To import, use the ID `ORG/<tenant>/<locale>/<screen>` or `APP/<application_id>/<locale>/<screen>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_branding_text" "login" {
  screen = "login"
  locale = "en-US"
  text = {
    "login.heading" = "Sign in to Acme"
    "login.button"  = "Continue"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `screen` (String) Screen whose texts are customized, for example `common`, `login`, `sign-up`, `password-recovery`, `password-reset`, `password-reset-success`, `email-otp`, `sms-otp`, `totp`, `email-link-expiry`, `myaccount`.
- `text` (Map of String) Text values by key, for example `{ "login.heading" = "Sign in to Acme" }`. The keys are listed in the Console's *Text* tab of the branding section.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Application ID, for `type = "APP"`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, for example `en-US` (default) or `fr-FR`.
- `type` (String) `ORG` (the organization, default) or `APP` (one application).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<type>/<name>/<locale>/<screen>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_branding_text.login ORG/carbon.super/en-US/login
```
